name: George Roderick
bio: George Roderick claimed the butte north of Medora in April 1884 and began breaking ground on the butte east of town. In July 1884 he surprised two men among his horses at the Cantonment, part of a run of horse thefts. He traveled often with his teams between Medora, Jamestown and the Red River valley, once taking fifteen days through blizzards in December 1884. In late 1885 he moved from Casselton to Bismarck, then sold his outfit and went east with his wife, whose health was poor.
